newsitem.title: CHINA: China in $550 mln deal for German condensing units.
newsitem.headline: China in $550 mln deal for German condensing units.

text.p: China has signed a $550 million deal with Germany's ABB Kraftwerke AG to import two sets of double extraction condensing TG units, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
The import contract for the units was signed on Tuesday by the China National Technical Import & Export Corporation, the North China Power Group and the China National Tendering Centre, it said.
ABB Kraftwerke, a unit of the ABB group, won the contract through international tendering, it said.
The project to ensure stable supplies of heat and electricity for eastern Beijing would be completed by end-1998, it said. It gave no more details.
